title: Can routine chest CT with artificial intelligence tool be used for opportunistically osteoporosis screening? A preliminary study.
summary: A chest-CT AI tool was evaluated for opportunistic osteoporosis screening in patients with pulmonary disease; the result concerns screening performance, not fracture prevention or clinical benefit.
